svg.aria-label: Planar, FinFET and gate-all-around transistor structures
svg.title: Three transistor structures
svg.desc: Three schematic transistors left to right. Planar: the gate sits on top of a flat channel and touches one side. FinFET: the gate wraps three sides of a thin vertical fin. Gate-all-around: the gate surrounds stacked nanosheets on every side. TSMC nodes: 28 nm and earlier are planar, 16 nm to N3 are FinFET, N2 and A16 are nanosheet gate-all-around.
svg.text: Gate on top of a flat channel
Gate wraps a thin vertical fin
